Как это работает: Cooldown спрашивает са: How it works: Cooldown asks the services themselves (Anthropic, OpenAI and Google) which country requests reach them from — over the same path the agents’ requests take, so it doesn’t matter where the VPN runs: on the Mac or on the router. The request is anonymous, without your account; Cooldown has no server of its own. While the route is wrong, Claude Code and Codex don’t send messages, Cooldown itself doesn’t contact these services, and the agents’ apps are paused. When the VPN is back, everything resumes on its own.
Коды стран через пробел (RU — Россия, BY: Country codes separated by spaces (RU — Russia, BY — Belarus, CN — China). A route through any of them stops work.
